plain_description.what: Builds an admission table of candidate datasets for a second corpus with an answer key. Each candidate is checked on sourced conditions: at least 20 complete models, enough evaluation questions per cell, a closable content-overlap check, a key, a stated licence and the needed protocol columns.
plain_description.why: The thesis needs a second keyed corpus to show results are not specific to MMLU-Pro. This survey decides which candidate (SuperGPQA first) may enter.
plain_description.information: It would say which datasets are admissible and why the others fail. If SuperGPQA failed any condition, the second-corpus claim would become a stated limit. Result: built, not yet run as a result. Only the SuperGPQA row is filled, and it is provisionally admitted. The final analysis is deferred until the 14 other rows are complete. No result of record yet.
